_what: Every finishing tool a clip can go through, ours first. clip_tools.py reads this file. A row with engine 'ours' spends nothing; a row with engine 'higgsfield' is sent only after a live quote, through the spend guard. credits_s is Higgsfield's own quote at 480p, 2026-11-25.

tools.name: Carry a clip on
tools.instead_of: making a second clip that has to match

looks.soft: A very large diffused soft light from the front and one side, like a big overcast window out of frame. Shadows roll off slowly with no hard edges. Low contrast, neutral-warm colour, natural skin.
looks.window: Daylight from one window at the side: bright on the near side of the face, gentle falloff to the far side, soft shadow on the wall.
looks.morning: Early morning sun, low and warm, coming from one side, with long soft shadows and a clean pale fill.
looks.golden: Low golden-hour sun from behind and one side: a warm rim on hair and shoulders, soft warm fill on the face.
looks.barbershop: Overhead shop fluorescents with warm bulbs around the mirror: clean even light on the face, warm spill behind.
looks.night: Night indoors: one warm lamp as the key from the side, the rest of the room dim, a faint cool spill from outside.
looks.flat: Even overcast daylight from every side, no visible shadows, true skin colour: plain phone-footage light.

tools.name: New camera on the same moment

moves.push-in: a slow push in toward the face
moves.pull-out: a slow pull back that shows more of the place
moves.orbit-left: the camera arcs round to the left
moves.orbit-right: the camera arcs round to the right
moves.close: a tight close shot of the face
moves.hands: a tight close shot of the hands and what they hold
moves.wide: a wide shot that shows the whole place
moves.handheld: handheld, a little drift and shake

tools.name: Match the colour
tools.instead_of: a paid grade at 3.5 credits a second

tools.name: Sound effects on the cuts
tools.instead_of: a bought sound pass; a sound already in the bank is never made twice

tools.name: Vertical to wide or square
tools.by: the edit line crops and resets the words
tools.instead_of: a paid reframe at 2.25 credits a second
